app_caption: Educational simulation using ECB daily reference exchange rates. It does not execute trades or use real money.
exchange_help: Exchange rates come from the daily reference rates published by the European Central Bank (ECB).
quote_help: This is the currency in which the entire portfolio is valued. Other currencies are converted into this reference currency for comparison.
catalog_warning: The currency catalogue could not be prepared ({error}).
no_spot: No currencies are available for reference currency {quote}.
markets_available_live: {count} currencies available against {quote} · ECB reference data
select_all_help: This can make the Monte Carlo simulation much slower. A small set of currencies is easier for a first test.
cryptocurrencies_help: Select the currencies into which the agent may convert part of the portfolio, for example USD, GBP, JPY or CHF.
rules_caption: Rules can be edited before running the backtest. For an out-of-sample test, they should then be frozen.
ema_help: Trend: compares a short exponential moving average with a longer one.
rsi_help: Momentum: values range from 0 to 100. The interval defines when points are added.
macd_help: Momentum/trend: compares the MACD line with its signal line.
min_score_help: Only coins reaching this score enter the portfolio.
max_weight_help: Limits how much of the portfolio can be allocated to one coin. Remaining capital stays in cash.
holder_count_help: Each holder converts the initial capital into one currency and keeps it until the end.
holder_assets_help: Select exactly one different currency for each holder.
holders_missing: {count} more coin(s) must be assigned to the holders.
rule_ema_summary: - **EMA ({points} point/s):** adds points when EMA{fast} > EMA{slow}. It seeks an upward trend: the recent average is above the longer-term average.
rule_rsi_summary: - **RSI ({points} point/s):** adds points when RSI({period}) is between {minimum:.0f} and {maximum:.0f}. RSI measures momentum on a scale from 0 to 100.
rule_macd_summary: - **MACD ({points} point/s):** adds points when MACD({fast}, {slow}) is above its signal line ({signal}). It seeks positive momentum.
rule_entry_summary: - **Entry:** a coin is eligible if it reaches **{score} points**. Maximum weight per coin is **{weight:.0f}%**; the rest remains in cash.
methodology_info: These rules are mechanical criteria, not predictions. To keep the experiment defensible, define them before the test period and do not readjust them after seeing the result.
error_dates: The start date must be earlier than the end date.
error_holders_exact: Select exactly {count} coin(s) for the holders.
status_running: Downloading data and running the experiment...
fetching_ohlcv: Retrieving ECB reference exchange rates for {count} currency/currencies...
holder_data_error: No data are available for the selected holders: {symbols}
simulation_error: The simulation could not be completed: {error}
initial_prompt: Configure the experiment on the left and click **Run simulation**.
result_saved: Result stored in this session · {coins} currencies analysed · {holders} holders · period {start} — {end}
random_summary: The technical agent is approximately at the **{percentile:.1f}th percentile** of the {count} random simulations: {better} random agents finished with more capital.
humans_intro: You can upload a CSV with participant decisions. Each decision allocates up to {weight:.0f}% of the portfolio to the selected currency; the rest remains in the reference currency until the next decision.
allowed_choices: Accepted values in `choice`: CASH or any ticker among the analysed currencies (e.g. USD, GBP, JPY...).
educational_disclaimer: Educational use only. ECB rates are informational reference rates, not executable trading prices. Backtest results do not guarantee future returns and are not financial advice.
